manualInputs.name: Attack, defense, form, injuries, rest and travel
manualInputs.note: Attack, defense, injuries, rest and travel remain low-weight manual inputs; current form values come from the latest official warm-up result per team, and this check refreshed England, Portugal and Algeria from the official 10 June warm-up results.

warmups.name: FIFA pre-tournament warm-up results
warmups.note: Official article still shows Published 7 Jun 2026, but the live page now includes 10 June results including England 3-0 Costa Rica, Portugal 2-1 Nigeria and Bolivia 0-4 Algeria.

notes: 截至 2026-06-11 检查，FIFA 男足排名公开页显示 Just updated: 11 June 2026；下一次官方更新为 20 July 2026。球队具体排名与积分仅在成功核验后写入，避免用旧数值冒充新排名。
截至 2026-06-11 检查，FIFA 官方 standings 页面显示 12 个小组均处于 P/W/D/L/GD/Pts 全 0 的开赛前状态，并已展示官方淘汰赛签位框架。
截至 2026-06-11 检查，FIFA 官方 scores-fixtures 页面已展示 104 场完整赛程；本地 matches 数据已从 72 场小组赛扩展为包含淘汰赛官方占位签位的 104 场快照。
FIFA 于 2026-06-02 确认最终 48 队名单；2026-06-11 复核到公开 SquadLists-English.pdf 仍为 Version 1，页脚时间戳更新为 Thursday, 11 June 2026 | 01:09 UTC，未见可证实名单替换。

FIFA 官方热身赛文章在 2026-06-11 检查时已纳入 10 June 赛果；据 warmups.json 既定公式，England 的 form 从 0.68 调整为 0.69，Portugal 保持 0.69 但 latest-form source 更新为 Portugal 2-1 Nigeria，Algeria 则依据 Bolivia 0-4 Algeria 从 0.60 调整为 0.61。
